Reference selection

Why fused_v10_clean.ply is the correct comparator

V10 is the only production model (Depth-Anything-V2-Base-hf, 49 fused frames, voxel 0.04 → stat 30/1.5 → adaptive DBSCAN). The pipeline produces the same two PLYs under reconstruction/: fused_raw.ply (voxel+stat) then fused_clean.ply (DBSCAN). The V10 experiment's final artifact is test/fused_v10_clean.ply (31,874 pts, per test/fused_v10_diag.json clean_points: 31874). V9, V8, 15-frame and 5-frame PLYs use different models/frame counts and are not comparable. The comparison below therefore pairs production reconstruction/fused_clean.ply (33,246 pts) ↔ V10 test/fused_v10_clean.ply (31,874 pts), with reconstruction/fused_raw.ply ↔ test/fused_v10.ply as the raw auxiliary. test/fused_v10_confidence.ply is the confidence reference.

2 · Bounding-box comparison

COLMAP world coordinates are arbitrary (no georeferencing — COLMAP_relative). Absolute bbox position, orientation and scale differ per COLMAP run. Axis-aligned extents are therefore not comparable across runs; PCA / oriented extents and thinness ratios are the invariant shape metrics.
MetricV10 cleanProd cleanWhat it means
Axis-aligned extent (x y z)6.549 × 2.782 × 3.2869.884 × 7.394 × 1.671Ratio 1.51 / 2.66 / 0.51 — looks divergent, but axes are arbitrarily rotated between COLMAP runs.
Diagonal7.83712.457Ratio 1.59 — same arbitrary-scale effect.

PCA extent (x′ y′ z′)6.618 × 4.437 × 0.96110.177 × 6.955 × 1.556Invariant: thin-slab shape preserved.
PCA thinness z′/x′0.1450.153+5% — essentially identical flat terrain.

Takeaway: the oriented shape matches V10 to within a few percent. Axis-aligned differences are gauge freedom, not a stretching bug.

5 · Nearest-neighbor distance between production and V10

Pair (sampled 5k pts, KD-Tree)Medianp90MeanContext
Prod → V10 unaligned (raw coords)1.953.392.11Meaningless — different origins.
Prod → V10 centered + scaled + PCA-aligned0.01240.04940.0196Key metric — invariant to COLMAP gauge.
V10 → Prod (same alignment)0.01890.06090.0262Symmetric — no one-sided missing region.
Reference V9 ↔ V10 (same COLMAP run, 86 frames)0.02060.051–0.054—Prod vs V10 (0.012) is tighter than V9 vs V10 despite different registration — strong validation.
Interpretation: after removing the arbitrary translation, rotation and scale, the production cloud lies within ~0.012 diag-units of the V10 surface (median) — about 1.2% of the scene diagonal. The symmetric check (0.019) confirms neither cloud has a large exclusive region. In absolute terms that is ~0.09 scene-units at V10 scale, comparable to the voxel size 0.04.
Method: both clouds centered at their means, isotropically scaled by their diagonals to unit size, rotated by R = E_prod · E_V10ᵀ (PCA alignment, determinant-corrected) with brute-force 8-sign search for the best median. 5k random query points, Open3D KD-Tree, Euclidean distance.

9 · Code changes & tests

Were any pipeline bugs found?

No. All quantitative differences trace to the different COLMAP registration (22 images from a 43-frame trimmed clip at 1 fps vs 55 images from the full 86-frame sequence) and the resulting arbitrary COLMAP gauge (origin/rotation/scale). Shape invariants (PCA thinness, voxel occupancy, PCA-aligned NN) agree to within a few percent, tighter than the known V9↔V10 inter-version variation. No stretching, spikes, holes, sheets or scale bugs detected. Therefore no reconstruction code was changed in Phase 5B.
One pre-existing timing bug (StageTimer elapsed_s captured inside with block → 0 s) was fixed during Phase 5A rerun, before this validation — not a Phase 5B change.

Final conclusion

✓
Validation passes — production reconstruction is numerically and visually consistent with V10.
The pipeline reproduces the validated V10 algorithm behavior-for-behavior (same intrinsics, same gates, same voxel/DBSCAN/confidence formulas, same depth model). Observed deltas in absolute position/scale are COLMAP gauge freedom, not pipeline drift; shape-preserving metrics (PCA ratios, voxel occupancy, PCA-aligned cross-NN 0.012 median — tighter than V9↔V10's 0.021) and visual renders show a coherent thin-slab terrain with no defects. Confidence and metadata remain honest (COLMAP_relative / false / null, no metric claims). Recommendation: no code changes required. Treat outputs/phase5a_real_test/ as the valid disposable validation run; do not promote it to a V10 reference artifact. Proceed to next phase.
